description: Synthetic-only ENE-03 dissipative energy-closure case with a nonzero constant five-coordinate external generalized force. External generalized work is kept signed and separate from structural damping and path-axis friction dissipation. All numerical values are analyst-authored software/numerical verification fixtures, not CNC machine parameters.

provenance.parameter_source: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE: ENE-03 uses the ENE-02 analyst-authored structural damping/friction fixture and adds a small mixed-sign constant external generalized-force vector to exercise signed generalized-force power accounting. SRC-000369 and SRC-000370 identify generic linear-motor/feed-drive model context; SRC-000372 supports RK4; SRC-000374 supports only the conventional gamma_n floating-point bound form. No cited source supplies these numeric values or proves the analyst-declared outer energy/power/trajectory bounds.

mechanical.note: All nonzero D0 diagonal coefficients, viscous friction, Coulomb friction, and smoothing speed are synthetic fixture values. D0 is diagonal positive definite in this fixture; no coefficient is sourced from a machine.

electrical.note: Every value is a synthetic fixture. Ke and Kf remain equal in SI units to retain reciprocal electromechanical power transfer; they are not catalogue values or a motor selection.

actuator.displacement_definition_and_sign: Synthetic actuator displacement ell_a = 0.1*q1 + s, with positive ell_a defined by positive s and positive q1 contributions; all coefficients are fixture values.

controller_and_loads.note: Constant nonzero mixed-sign synthetic generalized force in [Q_x_common,Q_yaw,Q_bending,Q_torsion,Q_s] order, selected to align with the signed initial generalized velocities and exercise positive external input work. The external-work term remains signed and is reported independently from D0 structural damping and axis friction dissipation. This continuous-time constant load is not a measured machining load or machine rating.

metrics.energy_residual_noise_floor_method: Pre-run ENE-03 synthetic-fixture envelope plus binary64 operation-bound analysis. The analyst declares upper bounds for stored-energy evaluation, RK4 trajectory propagation, net-power evaluation/trajectory propagation and time-grid effects before integration; the runner independently derives h/16 composite-Simpson accumulation and energy-residual subtraction bounds using gamma_k=k*u/(1-k*u). No residual from the executed trajectories is used to set this floor. This is a numerical roundoff-noise screen only; it excludes RK4 truncation and model/parameter uncertainty.
metrics.energy_residual_noise_floor_source: Analyst-declared synthetic ENE-03 energy/dissipation/external-work envelope and roundoff propagation assumptions. SRC-000374 supports the standard gamma_k expression only; the supplied maximum-energy, power, trajectory and time-grid bounds are synthetic assumptions and have not been independently proven or measured.
metrics.state_comparison_scale_source: Per-component characteristic magnitude anchors explicitly declared for this synthetic ENE-03 fixture before integration. The values are scale descriptors in their respective physical units, not tolerances, state bounds or acceptance criteria.
metrics.note: The normalization scale/floor and roundoff noise floor are synthetic pre-run declarations; the normalized closure threshold is intentionally null so this case cannot report engineering PASS. The external generalized-force vector and analyst-supplied envelope/trajectory roundoff bounds are assumptions, not proved by the runner. Config schema v4; manifest schema v7.
